reuse.why: The new handler and existing consumers reuse RSchedule, recurConfigToRSchedule, and the extended shared weekend-adjustment helper.

duplication.why: Date adjustment and holiday matching remain shared, although getNextDate and getUpcomingDates repeat the daily-frequency lookahead selection.

placement.why: Calendar policy stays in shared/schedules.ts, configuration belongs in the schedule model, and handler registration follows the existing server structure.

scope.why: All changes support the requested daily skipping, range handler, holiday handling, or their tests.

maintainability.why: The policy remains centralized and the additions are focused, though callers must coordinate nullable adjusted dates and daily lookahead selection.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected consumers, including getDatesInRange, use getDateWithSkippedWeekend for date adjustment.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated daily lookahead selection is directly recognizable; holiday matching and adjustment are shared rather than reshaped into copies.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains frequency and holidays parameters plus a daily-frequency branch returning null; all affected adjustment call sites continue using it.
